correctness.rationale: All quantifiers range over q≥2, distinct symbols, positive run lengths, and every finite factor length n≥1. A circular mixed complete class must use only allowed directed transitions. With at least three circular runs, rotating makes each full block interior, forcing exact source-run length and hence a period power. The sole binary two-run case splits into both runs >1, singleton-run, and unit pair, giving the claimed exhaustive exceptional classes. Unary classes are immediate and disjoint. Eventual divisibility support determines the primitive period, while initial values recover the run histogram. All 31,840 bounded exhaustive and 1,600 seeded larger-alphabet class-set tests passed. No infinite conclusion is based solely on enumeration.

value.rationale: Complete cyclic-conjugacy classes are a natural precise invariant in combinatorics on words, unlike arbitrary observed rotations. The theorem identifies every such class at every length for the entire distinct-letter periodic-run family; the sharp q=2 versus q≥3 change and inverse recovery of the full run-length multiset give structural information not implied by general upper bounds or isolated finite counts. It provides a canonical solved model for how Lie complexity remembers run statistics but loses order.
